== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Gray Island]] is a mysterious, floating landmass located at the edge of the [[Aion Sea]]. It is characterized by its deceptive appearance; while it can look like a pristine natural landscape of rolling green hills and dense forests designed to appeal to clients, it is actually densely populated. The island is largely defined by its secret and disguised nature, containing endless catacombs and hidden locations. Much of the territory is obscured by a supernatural mist known as [[Bastion's Veil]], which serves to hide the island from the sight of [[Elders]]. Physically, the island is believed to be the massive corpse of a [[Great Elder]] or the [[Dead Mother]]. Its geography reflects this biological origin, featuring a surface made of clammy skin rather than soil, with seaweed growing from natural wounds and a landscape that resembles a distended belly. Ten curved bone spires rise from the center like a rib cage, and the environment can smell of decaying meat and vegetation. While much of the island appears untouched by humanity, it contains a large [[white reception hall]] for [[Consultants]] and is managed by [[Architects]] to maintain a specific aesthetic. Parts of the island have also been affected by blight, appearing as withered, ash-covered regions that feel filled with hatred.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Shera]] finds herself on the Island, a location where her freedom to leave is contingent upon her refrain from killing unrelated individuals. During her stay, the Heart arrives at this setting. While on the Island, [[Shera]] attempts to burn off excess energy by jogging around its terrain. Ultimately, the Heart disappears while on the Island.}}
